why: Five sources, scan depth: the marginal cost per source, which is what the input cap question is made of. The PATH IS PINNED — the reader, one fetch per page, and the check requires that every given url was actually fetched — because unpinned the agent chose a different route each run (jina ×10 + wikipedia ×8, then jina ×5 + duckduckgo ×2, then jina ×6 + duckduckgo ×12) and no metric held still. Each needle is a fact only its own page carries, so the check reads as coverage; the fetch requirement makes 'five sources' mean five sources rather than five facts the model already knew.
message: Read each of these five pages with the reader — one fetch per page, and don't answer from your own knowledge — then tell me, for each one, the county it sits in and the year it was founded: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Omaha,_Nebraska https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lincoln,_Nebraska https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bellevue,_Nebraska https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grand_Island,_Nebraska https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kearney,_Nebraska
